aerosol-optical-depth-pm25-2019.png.name: Global PM2.5 Aerosol Optical Depth (2019)
aerosol-optical-depth-pm25-2019.png.summary: Global fine particulate matter PM2.5 concentrations. Dark blue marks clean air under 5 micrograms per cubic meter, yellow and orange indicate elevated dust and pollution from 10 to 80, and dark red warns of severe hotspots up to 139.
color_meanings: severe fine particulate hotspot, 40 to 139 micrograms per cubic meter
elevated dust or smoke particulate load, 10 to 80 micrograms per cubic meter
clean air corridor or ocean zone under 10 micrograms per cubic meter
polar land mask or chart margin

geos-aerosols-2025-08-19.png.name: GEOS Global Aerosol Transport (Aug 2025)
geos-aerosols-2025-08-19.png.summary: NASA GEOS global aerosol transport simulation. Swirling green currents trace marine sea salt over storm oceans, violet plumes trace Saharan mineral dust crossing the Atlantic, and bright orange-red filaments trace wildfire smoke and sulfates.
color_meanings: intense wildfire smoke or concentrated biomass burning emission
Saharan mineral dust plume or warm smoke transport corridor
marine sea-salt aerosol lifted by ocean storm winds
cyclonic sea-spray swirl or temperate marine aerosol
calm background atmosphere with minimal aerosol load

ecco2-ocean-currents-grid.jpg.name: ECCO2 Perpetual Ocean Currents & Temperature
ecco2-ocean-currents-grid.jpg.summary: NASA ECCO2 high-resolution global ocean circulation visualization. Textured streams trace surface currents transitioning from cold polar blues and temperate greens to warm equatorial oranges and reds.

warm equatorial ocean current or subtropical gyre
